_about: Remake-only chests as new OoTR locations, and rule changes for OoTR chests the remake reshaped (tools/rando/parity/chests.py; evidence per location: data/rando/chests_locations.json). Rules are at least as strict as the game: GC maze (every rock type), KF Storms Grotto (the remake's Deku Scrub brothers: reflect their nuts), SFM Wolfos Grotto (the remake covers it with a Song of Storms lid), GV Crate Freestanding PoH (a chest reached by the child's Cucco glide). Grotto pass (audit_overworld): KF Bridge Ledge Chest is one location for its Kokiri Forest and Lost Woods copies, reached by Lost Woods' bridge bean platform; HF Redead Grotto Chest is the ReDead room behind Hyrule Field's storm lid (OoTR's Kak Redead Grotto Chest and LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest are absent).

_why.LLR Tower Chest: SETTLED IN GAME: the chest HyruleField/chest/17445672702269453589 (-151.9,162.0,265.3) sits on the tower's terrace, reached by the adult with the Hookshot up the vine wall: seen by three other remake randomizers' players (Kaepora, Br00ty's OOTRR tracker, Clawshot's maintainer 17/11). The earlier stopgap asked for both a child route into the silo and the adult Hookshot route (OotrR study); the child route isn't real. can_use(Hookshot) is adult-only in OoTR.
_why.GC Maze Left/Center/Right/Fourth Chest: LOOSENED to each chest's own route: Left and Center can_blast_or_smash; Fourth can_use(Megaton_Hammer) or (has_explosives and can_use(Silver_Gauntlets)); Right can_blast_or_smash and can_use(Silver_Gauntlets). From the collision mesh (tools/reach.py, `python tools/reach.py verify` passing; NavGrid over x -51..-12, z -12..12 at 0.25 m from the upper Goron City floor (-20,115,-3), standing on rock tops not allowed, a route counted only where it never narrows below the age's CctRadius: adult 0.35, child 0.23 m). Rocks by actor: Obj_BrokenRock_A_01 brown = bombs or hammer; Obj_BrokenRock_A_02 bronze = hammer only (ChemicalRef Dummy, fact table; drops_regions_o2 review); Obj_LiftRock_B_01 silver = Silver Gauntlets. Results (adult): nothing -> no chest; bombs -> Left, Center; hammer -> Left, Center, Fourth; Silver Gauntlets alone -> none; bombs + silver -> all four; hammer + silver -> all four. Child: bombs -> Left, Center (narrowest gap on the way 0.57 m half-width). This reproduces every in-game report: Kaepora (all rocks reset: hammer alone opens Center, Left and Fourth, not Right; Silver alone none; bombs + Silver all four; a child with bombchus Center and Left) and Robophill via OotrR (Left/Center maze rocks, Fourth a hammer rock). Where the mesh's route was looser than an in-game rule, the in-game one is kept: the Fourth chest's bombs-only route existed only while bronze rocks were read as bombable. Parity note: OoTR's Silver-Gauntlets-only branch (OoTR's Left/Center/Right) has no route in the remake's maze (its silver boulders stand behind brown rocks): remake level design. Was: can_use(Megaton_Hammer) and can_use(Silver_Gauntlets) for all four (one rule clearing every rock type).
_why.GV Octorok Grotto Chest: The chest lies 3.19 units under water in the grotto: Kaepora and Clawshot both saw that the scales don't get Link to it and the Iron Boots do. Was True.
_why.LH Fairy Note 06 Chest: Clawshot, played: the shore chest HyruleField/chest/17023457248274633121 (-297.4,131.3,558.1, adult map only, beside Note 06 and an Enemy_Poe) is reached only with the lake refilled; the Poe need not die. Files agree: it stands at the full lake's surface (Obj_LakeHrl_WaterPlane_A_05/A_08 at y 130.8), on the west shore's rocks, with the drained lakebed's rocks and fallen trees 10 units below (y 118-122). A remake-only chest: no OoTR rule to keep.
_why.LH Grotto Chest: Clawshot, played: the four timed candles (Obj_CandleStick_TimeExtinguish_A_01, 15 s; HidingHole_Level_Hole_30 ANDs their Burning outputs) can't all be lit by Din's Fire, which lights three: a child lights the fourth with a Deku Stick from a lit one, an adult with an arrow shot through a lit one; Fire Arrows alone light all four. A remake-only chest (the remake replaced OoT's three scrubs): no OoTR rule to keep. Was has_fire_source.
